caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornate clock featuring a circular clock face at the top, enclosed within a round, gold-trimmed frame with a small finial at the very top. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals and black hour and minute hands, and the time shows approximately 3:08. The main vertical section below the clock face is rectangular and bordered with brown, decorated in the center with a floral and leaf motif in gold, green, and blue on a white background. Two blue curved metal supports extend from the base of the clock face to the upper corners of the rectangular lower section, each featuring a central decorative element. The base of the clock is a rectangular box, primarily brown, and prominently displays a colorful pastoral scene with a watermill, a stream, a tree, a red-roofed building, and a small bridge. The background of the drawing is beige, and two faint technical outline sketches of the clock, one on each upper corner, are present, showing additional views and measurements. There is handwritten text below the clock that reads "1/4 ACTUAL SIZE" and "FACE OFF CENTER AS INDICATED." The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Clock
